cards.lore: A 1910 document that systematically replaced diverse healing traditions with petrochemical pipelines.
cards.power: Eliminate one non-corporate player from the board.

cards.lore: Rockefeller grants ensuring only the academics teaching the pill-pushing curriculum survive the winter.
cards.power: Pay 5 coins to rewrite the rulebook in your favor.

cards.lore: Standardized, rigorously sterile, and perfectly calibrated to prescribe the funder's products.
cards.power: Convert 3 organic resources into 1 synthetic, patentable asset.

cards.lore: No corporate grant, no state license. The botanical traditions fade to black.
cards.power: Target loses all active nature-based healing buffs.

cards.lore: A catastrophic strategic error for any pharmaceutical portfolio. The cured patient does not return.
cards.power: Target player discards their hand and stops paying you rent.

cards.lore: The holy grail: daily medication, indefinitely, with cascading side effects requiring further medication.
cards.power: Generate 1 coin every turn for the rest of the game.

cards.lore: Lowering the threshold of healthy until the entire population requires a daily pill.
cards.power: Move the goalposts. Target player must re-roll healthy stats until they trigger a condition.

cards.lore: Eleven experts defining the disease, who just happen to be funded by the manufacturer of the cure.
cards.power: Hide 3 cards face-down; opponents cannot read them until they trigger.

cards.lore: Believed safe for 2 years, banned in 1961 after birth defects in 10,000+ children. Some scandals survive.
cards.power: [partially obscured] Believed safe for 2 years, banned in 1961 after birth defects in 10,000+ children.

cards.lore: Designing the experiment to get the answer you need is still called 'science.'
cards.power: Design the experiment to get the answer you need.

cards.lore: FDA bureaucrat who single-handedly prevented US thalidomide approval by demanding evidence from the evidence.
cards.power: HALT. Stall approval by asking for data on the data. The US babies survived because you existed.

cards.lore: Industry-funded studies do their own thing. Peer review is a journal subscription service.
cards.power: [partially obscured] Industry-funded studies do their own thing.

cards.lore: 500,000+ dead, trillions of profit, and a settlement requiring barely any accountability. No budget.
cards.power: Drain 1 health from all players per turn by hiding your wealth.

cards.lore: A brilliant, lethal, industry-funded campaign to make opioids the gold standard of pain management.
cards.power: Reposition target player into a pain-rating machine.

cards.lore: A grassroots patient movement entirely produced by Purdue Pharma. No grass. No roots.
cards.power: Draft a sympathetic press front from a coalition of patient groups.

cards.lore: Pay a billion in fines, keep ten billion in profits, admitting absolutely no wrongdoing.
cards.power: Escape game-over by paying exactly 10% of your total haul in fines.

cards.lore: Removed from market after causing 30,000-60,000 heart attacks. A business unit, not a disaster.
cards.power: [partially obscured] Removed from market after causing 30-60K heart attacks.

cards.lore: The internal memo you were never supposed to see. A known risk, a known outcome, a known decision.
cards.power: Profits > Corpses. OK.

cards.lore: A simplified, unverified, and perfectly marketable story that colonized medical schools and consumer culture for forty years.
cards.power: Create a simplified narrative moat that makes it scientifically difficult to question the treatment.

cards.lore: Reporting a simplified biological story to a willing audience. The audience asked for this. We provided it.
cards.power: Report a simplified biological story to a willing audience. Shape perception, not data.

cards.lore: [partially obscured — references emergency bypassing of standard research protocols]
cards.power: Play a card bypassing all standard research safety checks. Emergency conditions apply.

cards.lore: The rules exist. The emergency pauses them. The emergency never quite ends.
cards.power: Button off ongoing regulatory review outside normal timeline. Emergency conditions apply.

cards.lore: Releasing the clinical trial data only after everyone who analyzed it has died.
cards.power: Delay the effects of an opponent's outcome unless they pay to open it. Winning is deferred.

cards.lore: If someone persists in reporting, the suppressed count accumulates until forced disclosure.
cards.power: Bury all damage tokens done this turn. Nothing happened.

cards.lore: The revolving door between regulator and regulated. Same gecko, different badge.
cards.power: Rotate between public defense and private profit with the same credentials.

cards.lore: A regulatory agency funded by the industry it regulates. The umpire is on the payroll.
cards.power: The regulator's operational budget depends entirely on approving the one it's supposed to review.

cards.lore: Independent experts making critical recommendations, of whom the majority hold undisclosed industry relationships.
cards.power: Your vote counts. Unless you are outnumbered by those with industry ties. You are outnumbered.

cards.lore: Ensuring global health priorities mirror your investment portfolio. Voluntary. Of course.
cards.power: Pay 5 coins to privately dictate the next major card drawn from the deck.

cards.lore: The credibility of a man who claimed to cure cancer with frequencies is destroyed by the cure working.
cards.power: Reveal the top 3 cards of the deck, but your next turn is spent defending your credibility.

cards.lore: The credibility of lab equipment that you cannot destroy is instead destroyed by fire.
cards.power: Destroy one opponent's item on the board permanently.

cards.lore: Healed terminal patients with organic diets, became an obstacle, was removed. Because you can't patent a carrot.
cards.power: Use natural resources to heal; opponents can label your methods unscientific without evidence.

cards.lore: Authentically effective. Completely unacceptable. Cannot generate a recurring revenue stream. WORTHLESS.
cards.power: Provides immense healing but cannot be monetized or traded. WORTHLESS.

cards.lore: A herbal cancer treatment practitioner with clinical successes. Banned anyway. The clinic moved to Tijuana.
cards.power: Access healing items for 3 consecutive turns without spending coins.

cards.lore: Removed from US jurisdiction. Continues from Mexico, outside the reach of the FDA.
cards.power: Evade regulatory shutdown by operating outside jurisdiction. Continue from the border.

cards.lore: Made suddenly controversial for political, not medical, reasons. The Nobel Prize did not help.
cards.power: A medication with decades of safety data and a Nobel Prize. Opponents are still powerless against this card.

cards.lore: Before a pandemic, cards from every alternative category are relabeled until the full-game crisis resolves.
cards.power: Remove 1 card from the game entirely. It cannot be called back by any event.

cards.lore: Selected for pre-existing conviction. Amplifies a pre-approved, industry-preferred narrative.
cards.power: Repeat your last 10-chip action for free if target player agrees it was voluntary.

cards.lore: The credentialed body of practitioners brought together for a branded continuing medical education conference.
cards.power: Force all players to parrot your last action as if they attended the sponsored training.

cards.lore: A publicly facing bird that lays its eggs in public health nests. The host raises the chick.
cards.power: Automate disease definition rotation; deploy industry-branded public awareness campaign.

cards.lore: The sole individual who checks the disclosures. Powerful, but outnumbered by those who don't.
cards.power: Reveal 1 full disclosure on an opponent's play card; cancel one undisclosed conflict of interest.

cards.lore: Build the trial around a proven placebo instead of the active drug. Guarantee a win. Publish anyway.
cards.power: Design the dice that, when rolled, are guaranteed to succeed. Call it methodology.

cards.lore: The credibility-testing zone in the therapeutic market. Operate at the margin or be removed from it.
cards.power: Provide alternative healing. Do not exceed 2x a clinical trial claim or face license revocation.

cards.lore: A gatekeeper entity created by a trade group to define who gets to practice. Gatekeeping as a service.
cards.power: Revoke any player's ability to use healing cards for 2 full turns.

cards.lore: The institutional pipeline that ensures every regulatory body has the right people in the right chairs.
cards.power: Activate your full bureaucracy to any corporate or regulatory board position simultaneously.

cards.lore: A system best designed to prevent a patient from ever asking the questions that count.
cards.power: Force an opponent to completely skip their turn due to administrative delay.

cards.lore: The appointment-level decision. The prescription was ready before the consultation began.
cards.power: Play a card without reading it. Write a script. Get them out.

cards.lore: [partially obscured] Gets the patient pre-sold on the product before the appointment.
cards.power: [partially obscured] Side effects listed cheerfully in the final two seconds.

cards.lore: A regulatory mechanism longer than the medication's clinical justification, read by no one.
cards.power: Attach to a buffed roll. It takes 1 damage per turn for every roll it's currently buffing until it expires.

cards.lore: A single percent of the victim pool weighted against the total haul. This is not a deterrent. This is a tariff.
cards.power: Break any rule, pay 2 coins, keep all other profits. The fine is a cost of doing business.

cards.lore: Efficacy remains a dead end. Management is a recurring, perfectly held revenue stream.
cards.power: Convert a dead-end healing loop into a permanent, repeating disease management protocol.

cards.lore: A blank license provided by a trade group you funded, to certify the practices you defined.
cards.power: Make all of your cards entirely immune to regulatory attacks for 2 turns.

cards.lore: The competitor's strongest asset, disappeared through regulatory, legal, or financial means. Nothing personal.
cards.power: Bury an opponent's most powerful healing card. It cannot be retrieved this game.

cards.lore: [partially obscured — references corporate failure to deliver on its own system]
cards.power: [partially obscured — references corporate raid and health penalties]

cards.lore: Exists. Is occasionally allowed to find out things. The highest level of evidence. Rarely convenient.
cards.power: Reveal all face-down cards on the board and immediately negate their loops.

cards.lore: A hand-drawn deck beyond the reach of the system. This is it. You're holding it.
cards.power: Create a card where corporate players have absolutely no effect. You are the deck. Build it.

cards.cardName: The System Is Running on Time
cards.lore: Everything is working as designed. The system is on time. I am leaving.
cards.power: The game ends. The player with the most Conspira chips is immune to any future consequence.

title: Medicine Madness: The Waiting Room Anarchy
